mechanism: Ritonavir is a potent CYP3A4 inhibitor that may increase vitamin K metabolism and reduce anticoagulant effect, particularly relevant if vitamin K is used to counteract warfarin effects in patients on ritonavir-based antiretroviral therapy.
action: Monitor INR closely in patients requiring both ritonavir and warfarin/vitamin K; consider alternative antiretroviral regimens or anticoagulants if interaction becomes clinically significant.
